adaptations: Merged to-spec, to-tickets, and wayfinder into one alignment phase that ends in an operator-signed spec before autonomous work.

The spec is grilled with the operator instead of synthesized without an interview, and adds a definition of done, ID'd acceptance criteria, a per-criterion verification plan, an autonomy envelope with tripwires, and a low-level design.
Tracker publishing, triage labels, and the setup skill are dropped; the spec becomes the bottom draft PR's description and slices map to stacked PRs.
Wayfinder becomes map mode, stored in a file the operator picks, without a tracker, labels, or assignee claims.
Added depth tiers and a cold-implementer check, adapted from loop-me's definition of done.
Model-invocable, per the plugin's rule for bundled skills.
Harness tool names replaced with runtime-contract capabilities.
